SMTO-SKL-0008 — These Skill settings come from a different version of SMTO

GUID: 0a65bf0e-d8fb-4640-9bde-7e6805ad4c20
Slug: skill-configuration-version-unsupported
Domain: SKL · Subsystem: skl

What happened

  • The saved settings for this Skill were made by a newer or older SMTO than the one running now, so SMTO won't read them. It hasn't changed or deleted them.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Tell the person who manages SMTO whether it was recently updated, moved back to an older version, or had settings imported from another computer. This happens when the saved settings and the running SMTO come from different versions.
  2. Ask them to bring SMTO to the version that made these settings, or to a newer version that can upgrade them. A matching version can read the settings as they are, so nothing has to be typed in again.
  3. If you must save new values in this Skill's settings window instead, first open Settings, go to Data › Export / Import, and select Export JSON to save a backup. Saving replaces the old settings, and the backup lets you get them back later.

What success looks like

  • The Skill's settings window opens without a warning and shows your saved values.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send it to the person who manages SMTO. Don't edit or delete SMTO's saved files by hand to change the version number; that can lose your settings.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • The stored Skill configuration entry, or the canonicalized candidate, carries a schema_version or entry shape that differs from the version this Server's Skill definition supports.

What this means

  • Incoming canonical configuration or stored configuration has an unsupported schema version or entry shape. This diagnostic performs no provider access. The exact failing stage and retained receipt determine whether a request was sent; account, file or event identity must not be substituted during recovery.

Why this can happen

  • Incoming canonical configuration or stored configuration has an unsupported schema version or entry shape.

How to diagnose it

  • Compare exact integer schema version and stored envelope with the installed definition.

How to fix it

  • SkillConfigurationStore.load rejects a stored skill_configuration entry whose schema_version differs from the Skill's SkillConfigurationDefinition.schema_version (Web uses 1); validate rejects a canonical result with a different version. Run the SMTO release that wrote the entry, or upgrade to a release with a supported migration. Export a backup before saving a replacement in the editor, because Save overwrites the stored entry.
  • Use a runtime and Skill configuration with compatible schema versions. Preserve the stored configuration before following the supported upgrade path.

Retry and execution caution

  • Correct the recorded cause, then inspect current state and existing receipts before requesting another attempt.

How to verify the fix

  • Supported migration or compatible runtime/configuration versions preserve intended settings.

What not to do

  • Do not overwrite the original state with an incompatible version; use the supported upgrade path.

Technical notes

  • This diagnostic performs no provider access. The exact failing stage and retained receipt determine whether a request was sent; account, file or event identity must not be substituted during recovery.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
